description: R_COMP_SIG demo subset: 10 templated long rule sentences (one per template T1-T9 + one extra) x 10 few-shot LLM translation slots = 100 candidate rows, with z3 labels, all consensus/judge scores, sentence references, the vendor family map and the full-run headline numbers.
source: results/rcomp_candidates.jsonl + rcomp/work/rcomp_sentences.json + results/analysis.json + results/testability_*.json of gen_art_experiment_7

sentences.text: Each video that does not make tea, that is addictive, and that emits radiation across the electromagnetic spectrum has a high carbohydrate content, except if the video is changing.
When an integer is not depressing and requires practice, and the integer also is a known species of ambiortus, the integer affects females, except when the integer excludes meat.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (Integer(x) ∧ ¬Depressing(x) ∧ Require(x, practice) ∧ KnownSpeciesOf(x, ambiortus) ∧ ¬ExcludesMeat(x) → Affect(x, female))

sentences.text: Any complex number that requires talent and that is the species Ambiortus Dementjevi affects males, provided that the complex number is sad and does not have height.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (ComplexNumber(x) ∧ Require(x, talent) ∧ IsSpecies(x, ambiortusDementjevi) ∧ Sad(x) ∧ ¬Height(x) → Affect(x, male))

sentences.text: A rapper who attends the conference in person and who is not rewarded with a $30 gift card is short sighted as long as the rapper is always tired in the morning, unless the rapper is at the business conference.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (IsRapper(x) ∧ AttendInPerson(x, conference) ∧ ¬RewardWith(x, giftCard) ∧ AlwaysTiredInMorning(x) ∧ ¬At(x, businessConference) → ShortSighted(x))

sentences.text: Every iPhone that does not have a video mode and that has a hollow body is in Size Town, provided that the iPhone is deemed reliable, unless the iPhone is a type of food.

Except when the celestial body is a first automobile, every celestial body that blocks direct current and that is played by plucking is free to modify, provided that the celestial body is eco-friendly.

Anybody who is suspended from office, is a member of the university faculty, and will start working on coordination between the left and the right hands works more than 40 hours per week unless they are an employee in James's town.
When a solid maintains a roughly spherical shape, magnifies distant objects, and is played with a bow, the solid possesses adequate processing power, but only if the solid deforms elastically.
No singer who is found guilty, who presents their work at the conference, and who works full-time reasons, unless the singer is a member of the university faculty.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (Singer(x) ∧ FoundGuilty(x) ∧ PresentWorkAt(x, conference) ∧ Work(x, fullTime) ∧ ¬MemberOf(x, universityFaculty) → ¬Reason(x))
sentences.reference_fol_strong: ∀x (Singer(x) ∧ FoundGuilty(x) ∧ PresentWorkAt(x, conference) ∧ Work(x, fullTime) → (¬Reason(x) ↔ ¬MemberOf(x, universityFaculty)))

sentences.text: Anyone who does not work from home, thinks Santa Claus is made up, and is a young working professional is a citizen of Lawton Park unless they are provided with souvenirs.
sentences.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (¬WorkFrom(x, home) ∧ ThinkMadeUp(x, santaClaus) ∧ YoungWorkingProfession(x) ∧ ¬ProvidedWith(x, souvenir) → ResidentOf(x, lawtonPark))
sentences.reference_fol_strong: ∀x (¬WorkFrom(x, home) ∧ ThinkMadeUp(x, santaClaus) ∧ YoungWorkingProfession(x) → (ResidentOf(x, lawtonPark) ↔ ¬ProvidedWith(x, souvenir)))
